R7BL-grouse-atv-0003.name: 670 m W of Tooga Creek
R7BL-grouse-atv-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BL-grouse-atv-0003.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
10 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

plan: Drive: from Northern Rockies Regional Municipality, about 214 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Sierra Yoyo Desan Rd.
Park: 59.10629, -120.61415, where the truck road ends (unnamed gravel road); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: the unnamed road stretch, 4.5 km one way. About 90 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-56, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2020-02-25, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BL-grouse-atv-0003.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-56: about 664 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.04 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
